name: duopore-public-property-facts-completeness
description: Find missing property details before you finish a home listing.
keywords: find gaps in a home listing

interface.shortDescription: Find gaps in a home listing
interface.longDescription: Find missing property details before you finish a home listing. Share the listing facts you have and choose which fields you need. Get a checklist of gaps to fill before the listing is ready for your review. It checks the fields you chose. It does not inspect a property or decide which facts the law requires.
capabilities: Find gaps in a home listing
defaultPrompt: Which property details are missing from this listing?
Check these listing facts against my required fields.

positive.prompt: Use Property Facts Check with these explicitly supplied fictional inputs. Return the worksheet and limitations for my review: {"propertyRef":"P1","requiredFields":["bedrooms","parking"],"facts":[{"field":"bedrooms","status":"confirmed","value":"2"},{"field":"parking","status":"unknown","value":"unknown"}]}
positive.expected_behavior: Use only these supplied inputs; no external verification, saving, sending or invented facts. Expected structured result: {"summary":"1 of 2 required facts need confirmation.","rows":[{"propertyRef":"P1","field":"bedrooms","value":"2","status":"complete"},{"propertyRef":"P1","field":"parking","value":"unknown","status":"missing"}],"warnings":["Supplied facts only; no address, tenant screening, legal assessment or verification."]}
